purpose: CI regression for the retrieval service (RSV-12): every route on three synthetic laws, so a ranking change that does worse than the committed baseline fails. Synthetic text: never real law, and no quality claim.
corpus: texts.json: three synthetic laws written for this benchmark, published into a scratch database by the test
limitations: Synthetic laws of a few sections each; scores say nothing about retrieval quality on real law.
Judgments by the author of the retrieval code; not independently reviewed.
